mapper.sql: id, account_id, receipt_id, amount, type, transaction_date, description, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id WHERE pt.id = #{id}

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id WHERE pt.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id WHERE pt.receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id WHERE pt.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id WHERE pt.account_id = #{accountId} AND pt.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC

SELECT pt.id, pt.account_id, pt.receipt_id, pt.amount, pt.type, pt.transaction_date, pt.description, pt.create_time, pa.name as account_name, CAST(r.id AS CHAR) as receipt_number FROM payment_transaction pt LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON pt.account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON pt.receipt_id = r.id ORDER BY pt.transaction_date DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_transaction (account_id, receipt_id, amount, type, transaction_date, description) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{receiptId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{transactionDate}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_transaction SET account_id = #{accountId}, receipt_id = #{receiptId}, amount = #{amount}, type = #{type}, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
